seo.title: Privacy Policy | growthGrid Studio
seo.description: How growthGrid collects, uses and protects personal information when you visit growthgrid.studio, contact us or work with us on a project.

body.text:
This Privacy Policy explains how growthGrid ("growthGrid", "we", "us" or "our") collects, uses, stores and shares information when you visit our website, contact us, or inquire about our website design, UI/UX design and digital services.

Please read this Policy carefully. By using our website, you acknowledge that you have read it. Where consent is required by applicable law, we will ask for consent before processing the relevant information or placing non-essential cookies or similar technologies.
Information we collect

items: We collect information that you choose to provide and certain technical information generated when you use our website.
Contact details, such as your name, email address, phone number and company name, if you provide them.
Information included in messages, project briefs, inquiry forms or other communications you send to us.
Any other information you choose to share when discussing a potential or ongoing project.

body.text: Information collected automatically

When you visit the website, our website hosting, security and analytics tools may process technical information such as your IP address, browser and device information, pages viewed, referring page, timestamps and diagnostic or usage data. The exact information depends on the tools enabled on the website and your cookie or privacy choices.

Please do not submit sensitive personal information through general contact forms.
Cookies and similar technologies

Our website may use essential cookies or similar technologies needed for website operation, security, or to remember a privacy preference. If analytics or other non-essential technologies are enabled, they may help us understand how visitors use the website.

Where required by applicable law, we will seek your consent before using non-essential cookies or similar technologies. You can manage available choices through the website's cookie settings, if provided, and you can also control cookies through your browser. Blocking some cookies may affect certain website features.

A browser setting alone may not stop all forms of analytics or similar data collection. Your choices and the technologies actually enabled on the website determine what is used.
How we use information

items: To respond to inquiries and communicate with you about our services.
To understand project requirements, prepare proposals and provide requested services.
To operate, maintain, protect and troubleshoot the website.
To understand website performance and usage, where the relevant analytics tools are enabled and permitted.
To prevent spam, fraud, misuse and security incidents.
To comply with applicable legal obligations and establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

body.text: We do not state that we use information for targeted advertising unless such tools are actually enabled and disclosed.
Legal basis and consent

Where applicable privacy law requires a legal basis, we process information as appropriate to respond to your request, perform or take steps toward a contract, comply with legal obligations, protect the website and our legitimate business interests, or rely on your consent. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it at any time. Withdrawal does not affect processing that took place before withdrawal.

The legal basis available to us may differ depending on your location, the type of information and the purpose of processing. We will not rely on consent where it is not an appropriate legal basis.
Sharing your information

We may share information with service providers who help us operate the website or run our business, such as website hosting and infrastructure providers, security providers, analytics providers, email providers and tools used to manage inquiries or projects. They may process information on our behalf for the services they provide.

We may also disclose information where reasonably necessary to comply with law, respond to valid legal requests, protect rights and safety, investigate misuse, or support a business reorganisation. We do not sell personal information for money. If our use of advertising or tracking technologies changes, we will update this Policy and provide choices or notices required by applicable law.
Third-party services

Our website may use hosting, security and analytics services, potentially including Vercel and Google Analytics, depending on the tools enabled at the time of your visit. These providers may process technical or usage data under their own privacy terms. Their actual use, settings and data flows should be checked against the live website configuration. We do not list advertising or email-marketing providers here unless they are actually used.

Third-party websites linked from our website are governed by their own privacy policies. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.
How long we keep information

We keep personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, including responding to inquiries, managing projects, maintaining records, resolving disputes and meeting legal or security requirements. Retention periods depend on the type of information and the circumstances.

We aim to delete or securely dispose of information when it is no longer needed, unless it must be retained for legal, accounting, security or legitimate business reasons. We will not promise a fixed deletion period unless our actual processes and backups support it.
Your privacy rights

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights to request access to, correction of or deletion of personal information; withdraw consent; object to or restrict certain processing; request a copy of information; or raise a complaint with a relevant authority. These rights are subject to legal conditions and exceptions.

To make a privacy request, contact hello@growthgrid.studio. We may need to verify your identity and will respond within the period required by applicable law. If a right does not apply to your circumstances, we will explain this where appropriate.
Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration or disclosure. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please avoid sending confidential or sensitive information through a general website form.
International transfers

Our service providers may process or store information in countries other than the country where you live. Data protection laws in those countries may differ. Where required, we will use appropriate safeguards or other lawful transfer mechanisms for international transfers.
Children's privacy

Our website and services are intended for businesses and general audiences, not specifically for children. We do not knowingly seek to collect children's personal information in circumstances where parental consent or other protections are required. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, contact us so we can review the request and take appropriate action.
Changes to this Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy when our website, services, data practices or legal obligations change. We will publish the updated version on this page and revise the effective date. Please review this page periodically.
Contact us

For questions, concerns or requests relating to this Privacy Policy, contact:
Email: hello@growthgrid.studio
Website: https://growthgrid.studio/
Organization name: growthGrid
